PLAN "12-Week Strength + Hypertrophy for Body Composition"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build maximal strength with hypertrophy support to improve body composition"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Foundation Strength & Hypertrophy I":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Accessory & Hypertrophy I":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hamstring_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
          glute_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Strength Maintenance & Conditioning I":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          overhead_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks) continued:
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Foundation Strength & Hypertrophy II":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Accessory & Hypertrophy II":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hamstring_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
          glute_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Strength Maintenance & Conditioning II":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          overhead_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 2: Volume Up & Strength Focus":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          squat 5x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Auxiliary Hypertrophy II":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
          glute_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Strength Maintenance & Conditioning II":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks) continued:
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 2: Volume Up & Strength Focus":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          squat 5x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Auxiliary Hypertrophy II":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
          glute_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Strength Maintenance & Conditioning II":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds

Notes:
- All exercises use canonical names exactly as listed.
- Reps: use two-dot range syntax only where ranges apply (e.g., 6..8). In this plan, specific sets use fixed reps per set; adjust as needed but keep format correct (e.g., 4x6).
- Phase and week progressions emphasize increasing volume and maintaining strength stimulus to support hypertrophy and body composition improvements.
- Scheduling assumes typical 3–4 training days per week with rest between sessions. Adjust as needed for client availability.
- If any exercise feels unsuitable for a client, substitute with a safe alternative from the same movement pattern (e.g., replace incline_press with bench_press if needed).
